data.summary: AGV-3 is the least reliable AGV based on the highest fault count, aborted tasks, incident counts, telemetry faults, lowest battery health, and overdue service.

findings.claim: AGV-3 is the least reliable AGV with 84 faults_90d, far above the next highest AGV-6 at 25, and it has the lowest battery_health_pct at 62 with last_service_date 2026-05-21.
AGV-3 records the highest aborted_tasks, with 86 in shift A and 72 in shift B, more than any other AGV-shift combination.
AGV-3 has the highest single-day incident_count of 9 on 2026-08-17 in shift A and dominates the incident list across multiple dates.
AGV-3 telemetry faults concentrate in October 2026, including 49 E52_NAV_LOST events on 2026-10-14 and 46 E40_BATTERY_LOW events on 2026-10-12.
AGV-3 is currently idle with service overdue true and the worst battery health of 62% among all AGVs.

data.recommendation: Immediately pull AGV-3 from rotation for overdue service and battery and navigation fault repair, then revalidate it in shift A and B before returning it to production.
